content: Pet recommendations should consider the player's activity, budget, and current progression. Expensive pets are not always the best upgrade.
Mythic pets like the Mythic Mithril Golem or Griffin are high value for late-game progression, usually granting powerful stat bonuses and unique abilities.
When Hypixel does not provide a usable head id, map pet types to representative skin usernames or UUIDs in local data (see data/petSkins.json).
Common pets (Rabbit, Chicken, etc.) are cheap to obtain and useful early game. Focus on utility and upgrades rather than rarity early on.
